name: hidro-self-service
description: HIDRO SELF-SERVICE - Hidrolavadora autoservicio multi-máquina (web + API + firmware ESP32)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hidro/shared && npm run build -w @hidro/state-machine && npm run build -w @hidro/api && npm run build -w @hidro/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @hidro/shared && npm run build -w @hidro/state-machine && npm run build -w @hidro/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @hidro/shared && npm run build -w @hidro/state-machine && npm run build -w @hidro/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hidro/shared && npm run test -w @hidro/state-machine && npm run test -w @hidro/web && npm run test -w @hidro/api
